实现者过程与运行背景 · 12 个过程问题 / 9 条建议 · 不自动归为框架问题

本任务已处理只描述应用侧处理结果，不代表 NocoBase3 上游已修复。

本轮过程记录

Implemented the device after-sales service and inspection coordination application (issue #497) in application source, then ran a repair round against 8 observed acceptance failures. All 8 were fixed and the full local logic/component suite (318 tests) passes; one self-inflicted regression from the message-centre fix broke 37 shell/layout tests and was caught and repaired in the same round. The only remaining blocker is the deliberate absence of any configured LLM/embedding service, so real AI Q&A/retrieval acceptance stays blocked/not_run.

问题 01 · verification

ESLint no-unnecessary-type-assertion failed on the duplicated service-token registry

本任务已处理

`pnpm lint` reported two errors, both at service-tokens.ts:51:22: '@typescript-eslint/no-unnecessary-type-assertion — This assertion is unnecessary since the receiver accepts the original type of the expression.' The rule is unfixable by narrowing scope.

原因（实现者自述）
Both copies of the shared service-token registry declared `registry.set(name, token as ServiceToken<unknown>)` even though `Map<string, ServiceToken<unknown>>.set` already accepts a `ServiceToken<T>` argument, so the cast added nothing and tripped the lint rule.
处理方式
Removed the redundant `as ServiceToken<unknown>` cast in both server/providers/service-tokens.ts and server/workflows/ticket-acceptance/server/service-tokens.ts; verified with scoped eslint, Prettier, and `tsc -p tsconfig.server.json --noEmit`.
影响 / 代价：未提供，不估算来源：Agent · retro.json
问题 02 · 实现阶段

AI knowledge-base Q&A cannot return generated answers or vectorize manuals

未解决

POST /service/assistant/ask always returns ai.status='blocked' with reason 'No language model service is connected'; the AI Knowledge Base manifests cannot be initiated/vectorized.

原因（实现者自述）
The application has no llmServices configured (server/config/ai.ts llmServices: []) and no embedding model or vector database. The Knowledge Base manifests are configured in config.yml, which is out of scope to edit, and initiation additionally requires an LLM service and embedding model that do not exist in this environment.
处理方式
Implemented the assistant endpoint and knowledge/manual keyword search over the application's own tables, and reported the AI generation capability honestly as blocked instead of fabricating answers. Manuals now persist an honest indexStatus/indexError. When an LLM and embedding service are configured, the interface is ready to consume them.
影响 / 代价：未提供，不估算来源：Agent · retro.json
问题 03 · 修复阶段

Defects 1+2a: separation of duties was not enforced and transition notes were optional

本任务已处理

An engineer could Return to processing an Awaiting-confirmation ticket they did not own, a supervisor could Submit for confirmation a Processing ticket, and both Submit-for-confirmation and Return-to-processing accepted an empty note.

原因（实现者自述）
database/seed-data/permission-sets.ts granted serviceEngineer `return` and serviceSupervisor `process`/`submit`, and client/pages/service/tickets/detail.tsx gated buttons only by permission+status, never by assignee. The transition handler validated status but not the actor role or note.
处理方式
Removed the cross-role grants from the seed data, added non-throwing `canAuthorizeAction` to server/routes/service-shared.ts, exported `TRANSITION_FROM`, `TicketTransitionError` and `transitionValues` from the ticket service, and enforced `actorMayAct` in server/routes/tickets.ts (process/submit require the assignee; accept/return/close require a non-assignee). Note emptiness is rejected with 400 `note_required`. The client now drives buttons and note requirements from a per-ticket `capabilities` map returned by `GET /:id`.
影响 / 代价：1 repair round; 6 source files changed (seed, service, 2 routes, client types, detail page), 1 new capability probe.来源：Agent · retro.json
问题 04 · 修复阶段

Defect 2b: the read-only observer could see resolution text and internal processing notes

本任务已处理

Opening an ordinary ticket as the observer showed the Resolution field and the full History, including internal notes such as “开始处理温区偏差”.

原因（实现者自述）
serviceObserver still held `events: allRecords` and `tickets: service.nonConfidentialTickets` (all non-confidential tickets rather than explicitly granted ones).
处理方式
Removed the observer's `events` grant and stripped `resolution` from the observer's ticket projection; the observer keeps the explicit non-confidential summary scope. Because the seed is insert-only, the enforcement is in application code and not only in the seed.
影响 / 代价：1 repair round; 2 files changed.来源：Agent · retro.json
问题 05 · 修复阶段

Defect 2c: a temporarily shared read-only ticket offered Start processing and returned 500 on click

本任务已处理

After a supervisor shared a ticket read-only, the sharer still saw the Start processing button; clicking it left the status unchanged but returned HTTP 500 instead of a clean 403.

原因（实现者自述）
The capability map did not exist, so the UI could not distinguish read-only sharing from ownership, and the denied transition path threw a generic error rather than an authorization rejection.
处理方式
The same `capabilities` map from Defect 1+2a now hides transitions the actor may not perform, and the transitions route returns a clean denial for an action the actor is not permitted to take.
影响 / 代价：Included in the Defect 1+2a change set.来源：Agent · retro.json
问题 06 · 修复阶段

Defect 3: DOCX attachments had no in-detail preview, and every attachment size showed as 0 B

本任务已处理

A DOCX row offered only Download/Remove, clicking its name did nothing, and both PNG and DOCX rows rendered the size as “0 B”.

原因（实现者自述）
client/pages/service/components/attachment-panel.tsx rendered Preview only for image/png and never mounted the file-component-ui OfficeOpenXmlPreview; the size field arrives from the server as a string and `Number.isFinite('156840')` is false.
处理方式
Added client/pages/service/components/attachment-preview-dialog.tsx, which reuses the extension's `FilePreviewContent` directly (not `FilePreviewDialog`, whose `resolveSafeFileUrl` rejects blob URLs), wired a Preview action for DOCX, and changed `formatBytes` to accept `number | string` and coerce with `Number(bytes)`. PNG + DOCX remains the deliberate ticket format matrix.
影响 / 代价：1 repair round; 3 files changed (1 new component).来源：Agent · retro.json
问题 07 · 修复阶段

Defect 4: the durable in-app inbox delivered messages but had no recipient-facing UI

本任务已处理

The notification log showed completed service.ticket deliveries, and the API isolated messages per user, but the signed-in shell had no inbox entry or unread badge and /notification-in-app is dev-only.

原因（实现者自述）
The notification-in-app plugin exposes its inbox route only under `defineDevRoutes`, so production had no route and no shell entry.
处理方式
Added an application-owned authenticated route `/service/notifications` with `authz: 'skip'` (a personal surface), an app-owned inbox page rendering the plugin's public `NotificationInAppInbox`, and a header bell. The provider is mounted around the signed-in shell only.
影响 / 代价：1 repair round; 5 files changed (2 new), 1 route added.来源：Agent · retro.json
问题 08 · 修复阶段

Self-inflicted regression: mounting NotificationInAppProvider in the shell broke 37 shell/layout tests

本任务已处理

tests/logic/client-settings.test.tsx, client-shell.test.tsx, tests/components/app-layout-routes.test.tsx and layout-i18n.test.tsx rendered an empty body; the provider threw `useClientApplication() must be used inside AppClientRoot` and `Unexpected service token: realtimeClientToken`.

原因（实现者自述）
`NotificationInAppProvider` calls `useApiClient()` and `useService(realtimeClientToken)`, which need the API client and realtime service. The test harnesses render `AppLayout` with a partial (or absent) application context, so wrapping the whole shell in the raw plugin provider made the layout unrenderable there. The offline realtime path is a framework service only `createApp` registers.
处理方式
Added client/layouts/components/inbox-runtime.tsx and inbox-runtime-context.ts. `InboxProvider` reads the application context directly, mounts the plugin provider only when both tokens are registered, and otherwise renders children; `InboxEntry` reads the unread count from an app-owned context that defaults to zero. `NotificationInAppProvider` was removed from app-layout.tsx. All 318 logic/component tests pass.
影响 / 代价：1 repair round; 4 files changed (2 new); 37 previously failing tests recovered.来源：Agent · retro.json
问题 09 · 修复阶段

Defect 5: no controlled way to run a registered schedule from the browser

本任务已处理

Settings → Scheduled tasks and its detail page are read-only; every probe of POST /schedules/:id/{run,trigger,execute,run-now,trigger-now} returned 404, so daily inspection generation and overdue reminders could not be triggered on demand.

原因（实现者自述）
The scheduler plugin's public contract exposes only `registerTarget`/`defineSchedule` and a read-only Settings/API surface. Its page modules are not importable (the package `exports` map has no route/page subpath), the store/target registry/occurrence history are private, and the Skill forbids replacing ScheduleDispatchJob or writing the schedule tables directly.
处理方式
Used the public `Schedule` class re-exported by `@nocobase/queue` (not a plugin deep import, not a direct table write). New server/providers/service-schedules.ts lists schedule projections and calls the real `Schedule.trigger()`, which dispatches the same `ScheduleDispatchJob` with the real scheduleId into the real occurrence store; new server/routes/schedules.ts exposes GET `/service/schedules` and POST `/service/schedules/:key/run`, authorized by reusing the existing `service.inspections:manage` composite action (a new grant-less composite would always 403). A dashboard “Scheduled tasks” card is the discoverable surface.
影响 / 代价：1 repair round; 8 files changed/new plus a new 8-test unit file.来源：Agent · retro.json
问题 10 · 修复阶段

Defect 6: the dashboard did not show per-engineer / per-group work-order counts

本任务已处理

The supervisor dashboard showed only overall status cards and a recent-ticket list; no engineer or A/B group counts appeared in the page or in GET /service/dashboard.

原因（实现者自述）
dashboard-service.ts aggregated tickets by status only and never joined the service_team_members tables.
处理方式
Added `teams`, `teamWorkload` and a `TeamWorkload` type to the dashboard provider, a `TeamWorkloadCard` on the dashboard, and bilingual labels. Counts respect the caller's ticket policy, so an engineer sees only their own workload and unreadable tickets never enter the totals.
影响 / 代价：1 repair round; 4 files changed.来源：Agent · retro.json
问题 11 · 修复阶段

Defect 7: manuals could not be maintained through the knowledge base, Markdown upload was rejected, and index status never advanced

处理结果未提供

The AI Knowledge Base list was empty and its Settings page 404'd; uploading the two Markdown manuals was rejected with “Only PNG images and DOCX documents can be attached”; manuals always reported indexStatus='pending' with no status UI and content was never indexed.

原因（实现者自述）
No knowledge base is configured (server/config/ai.ts is empty) so there is nothing to initiate/vectorize; the attachment format matrix applied the ticket PNG+DOCX allow-list to manual documents too; `setManualIndexStatus` had no caller and manuals had no stored body.
处理方式
Added manual `content` via an additive migration, made the Markdown upload owner-aware so manual documents accept Markdown while ticket attachments stay PNG+DOCX, stored the two demo manual bodies in the seed, and added `reconcileManualIndex`/`reconcileManuals` so status is honest: `blocked` with an `indexError` when no model/embedding is configured, `not_indexed` otherwise. Keyword search over the stored bodies still works for engineers.
影响 / 代价：1 repair round; 5 files changed (1 new migration).来源：Agent · retro.json
问题 12 · 修复阶段

Defect 8: the assistant lost its conversation on refresh and had no draft-confirm boundary

本任务已处理

After asking a question the retrieval result and input were gone on refresh (no storage), and there were no draft/cancel/confirm controls; the assistant never produced an editable draft.

原因（实现者自述）
assistant.tsx kept everything in component state and had no persistence or draft workflow.
处理方式
Added assistant-storage.ts (per-user browser storage) and rewrote the assistant to restore conversations after refresh, and to offer an explicit “insert into draft” action on the ticket detail page. Assistant output is a personal draft only: nothing is written to a ticket until the user explicitly confirms the transition inside the ticket form — no auto-save and no auto-close.
影响 / 代价：1 repair round; 3 files changed (1 new).来源：Agent · retro.json

实现者补充建议

来自可选过程笔记，不代表已独立确认；相同建议引用上方评审，其余保留原文。

建议 01 · 模板兼容

Service-token registry is duplicated between application source and the workflow Artifact

可自动化

server/providers/service-tokens.ts and server/workflows/ticket-acceptance/server/service-tokens.ts are byte-equivalent copies that must be kept in step by hand, so every edit — including the earlier lint fix — has to be mirrored or the workflow resolves a different token object than the provider.

建议改动

Generate the Artifact copy from the canonical source at build time, or have the build assert the two files are byte-identical so drift fails the build instead of silently breaking service resolution.

来源：Agent · retro.json

建议 02 · 模板兼容

A sharing rule's built-in selection.records(ids) compares the primary key as strings

可自动化

It fails validation for an integer primary key with `Filter value is invalid for Field "id" of type "integer"`, forcing the application to register a parameterized record access (`service.sharedTicket`) whose resolver emits a numeric `$eq`.

建议改动

Let record selections carry typed identifiers, or defer identifier coercion to the field type, so a built-in sharing rule works with integer keys without an application-level workaround.

来源：Agent · retro.json

建议 03 · Skill 与文档

`pnpm nocobase db apply` runs migrations and seeds but does not boot application providers

可自动化

Provider `boot()` registrations (workflow provisioning, scheduler targets, record accesses) only take effect when the real server starts, which is easy to mistake for a broken registration after a CLI-only apply.

建议改动

State this in the migrations/seeds reference and in the `db` command help: to verify provider-owned registrations, start the application; a successful `db apply` alone proves nothing about them.

来源：Agent · retro.json

建议 04 · Skill 与文档

`repository.createOne`/`updateOne` read the written row back through readContext

可自动化

Any `create`/`update` permission must also grant `read`, or the mutation fails at runtime with READ_FORBIDDEN even though the write itself was authorized.

建议改动

Document the read-back in the permission/Repository guidance so create/update permissions are always authored together with the read permission they implicitly require.

来源：Agent · retro.json

建议 05 · Skill 与文档

Source-loaded seed files must import siblings with a `.ts` extension

可自动化

`@nocobase/db` loads seeds with a direct Node `import()`, bypassing the TypeScript transform pipeline, so an extensionless sibling import fails at load time.

建议改动

Add the `.ts`-extension rule and an example to the migrations/seeds reference; ideally make the loader resolve extensionless sibling imports like the compiler does.

来源：Agent · retro.json

建议 06 · 模板兼容

The scheduler plugin has no public run-now/trigger entry point

可自动化

Its Settings page and API are read-only, its page modules are not importable (the `exports` map omits them), and the store/target registry/occurrence history are private. An application that must let an operator run a registered schedule on demand has no supported path and must reach into `@nocobase/queue`'s `Schedule.trigger()` directly, duplicating connection/adapter resolution.

建议改动

Expose a documented `triggerNow(scheduleId)` (or equivalent) on the scheduler service token, so an app-owned route can run the same target and occurrence record through the public contract instead of resolving the queue adapter itself.

来源：Agent · retro.json

建议 07 · Skill 与文档

NotificationInAppProvider hard-requires the API and realtime services

可自动化

The public provider calls `useApiClient()` and `useService(realtimeClientToken)`, so mounting it in the shell throws wherever those services are absent — including component tests and deployments without realtime — and `useNotificationInAppRuntime()` throws outside it. Mounting it around a layout makes the layout unrenderable in isolation.

建议改动

Have `NotificationInAppProvider` degrade gracefully (or export a non-throwing unread-count hook) when its services are missing, and document the expected mount point and the services it needs so app shell tests can provide them.

来源：Agent · retro.json

建议 08 · 脚手架默认值

Permission-set seeds are insert-only, so business-rule enforcement cannot rely on seed edits

可自动化

`202609100012_service_permission_sets.ts` skips existing rows (`if (existing) continue;`), so correcting a grant in the seed does not change an already-installed database. A repair that only edits the seed silently fails on existing installations.

建议改动

Either make permission-set seeds reconcile the grants they own idempotently (update-in-place for known roles), or document prominently that role enforcement must live in application authorization code, not in seed edits.

来源：Agent · retro.json

建议 09 · Skill 与文档

A composite resource action with no database grant always denies with 403

可自动化

`authorizeAction` requires a non-empty `database` policy, so a newly declared composite action that grants no collection policy can never be authorized. Reusing an existing composite action is the working pattern, but this is not obvious from the authorization reference.

建议改动

Document that every authorizable composite action must return at least one collection policy, and give the “reuse an existing composite action” pattern for a new endpoint that has no new data grant.

来源：Agent · retro.json

      "suggestedChange": "Document the read-back in the permission/Repository guidance so create/update permissions are always authored together with the read permission they implicitly require.",
      "mechanizable": true
    },

      "suggestedChange": "Add the `.ts`-extension rule and an example to the migrations/seeds reference; ideally make the loader resolve extensionless sibling imports like the compiler does.",

实际操作

  1. 以 engineer.a1 登录打开 WO-2026-0002（分派给陈工），点击 Start processing 并 Confirm，工单变为 Processing
  2. 点击 Submit for confirmation，空说明时 Confirm 按钮禁用；填写处理说明后提交，状态变为 Awaiting confirmation
  3. 以 supervisor 登录打开同一工单，Transitions 仅显示 Return to processing / Close work order；点击 Return，空退回说明时 Confirm 禁用，填写退回原因后确认，状态回到 Processing
  4. 再次以 engineer.a1 登录，填写补充说明重新 Submit for confirmation；以 supervisor 登录点击 Close work order 并确认关闭
  5. 刷新页面并重新登录工程师账号，打开已关闭工单核对只读性

观察结果

  1. Processing 时工程师侧 Transitions 只有 Submit for confirmation，无 Return to processing；Awaiting confirmation 时主管侧只有 Return to processing / Close work order，无 Submit for confirmation，未出现越权/非法跳步按钮
  2. 空处理说明与空退回说明时 Confirm 按钮均为 disabled，无法提交；填写后才可提交，满足空说明被拒绝
  3. 状态流转完整：pending_processing→processing→pending_confirmation→processing→pending_confirmation→closed，closedAt=2026-09-30T08:40:14.460，resolution 保留补充说明
  4. 已关闭工单对工程师与主管均无任何 Transitions 按钮，capabilities 全 false，页面显示 Closed 与最终 Resolution，刷新及重新登录后仍为 Closed
